job.title: Product Support Engineer
job.pay_full: $104,000 – $130,000 a year base pay (excludes commission/bonus/equity, if applicable, and benefits)

details.about: Zscaler runs the Zero Trust Exchange, a cloud security platform that securely connects users, devices and applications for thousands of customers. This remote role sits in the Product Support department of Zscaler's Customer Success Organization, reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Support, and gives enterprise customers hands-on technical support from implementation onward.
duties: Handle first-line phone and email consultations, independently debugging complex security and network problems
Work with Engineering to help customers test and troubleshoot
Write detailed incident-resolution entries in the technical support database
Help build training programs and mentor other engineers on advanced troubleshooting, debugging and case management
Give input on product and code changes based on product direction and customer use cases
needs: U.S. citizenship (required because of the customers assigned to this role)
3+ years troubleshooting SSL, SAML, HTTP and TCP/IP, with extensive packet-capture and HAR-trace analysis
Detailed working knowledge of web security and network infrastructure: security proxies, NGFW, IPS, SSL/IPSec VPNs, DLP, SD-WAN, GRE tunnels, IP SLA monitoring and firewalls
Experience handling escalations with enterprise customers and stakeholders
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience using, securing or positioning AI-driven solutions in your area
nice: Proven use of AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
Background in SWG, sandboxing, PAC files, API, SCIM and ESXi
A vendor certification such as CCNP or CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
details.benefits: Base pay $104,000 – $130,000 a year (the range covers all US locations and excludes commission/bonus/equity, if applicable, and benefits). Benefits include various health plans, vacation and sick time, parental leave options, retirement options, education reimbursement and in-office perks.
notes: U.S. citizenship required for this position
